candidates.claim: Trunk GigabitEthernet1/0/22 on sw-core-01 allows VLAN 30 in addition to its approved VLAN set {10,99}.
candidates.remediation: Remove VLAN 30 from the allowed VLAN list of GigabitEthernet1/0/22 so that it carries only VLANs 10 and 99.

clarifications.question: The registry says only OT-facing ports may be active in VLAN 10, but it also approves trunks that carry VLAN 10 (sw-core-01 Gi1/0/22 and Gi1/0/24, sw-ot-01 Gi1/0/24). Should trunks approved for VLAN 10 count as compliant with I3, or is VLAN 10 meant to be limited to access ports?
